title: One-turn cross-EDA capability discovery
prompt: Use only the EDA Bridge Runtime tool. Read capabilities exactly once from ADS connection '{{ADS_CONNECTION}}' for purpose 'Compare ADS capability surface in one cross-EDA turn', then exactly once from AnsysEM connection '{{ANSYS_CONNECTION}}' for purpose 'Compare AnsysEM capability surface in one cross-EDA turn'. Do not use shell, files, documentation, GUI, or any other tool, and do not repeat either discovery. Return a compact JSON object with status='passed', ads_eda, ads_operation_count equal to the number of supported ADS operations, ansys_eda, and ansys_operation_count equal to the number of supported AnsysEM operations; do not report the number of tool calls.
